stem: A colleague who is used to Universal Analytics asks you to "create a new view for the Dutch market" in a standard GA4 property. What is the most accurate response?

options.text: GA4 has no views; use comparisons, filters in reports or explorations, or a separate property if the data truly must be separate
Create a reporting view under the property in Admin, then add a view filter that keeps only sessions from the Netherlands
Create a second web data stream for the Dutch market, which acts as a view with its own filters and report settings
Create a subproperty for the Dutch market, which is how a standard GA4 property splits data the way views used to
